subject: Vendor activation: data escrow inquiry and procurement docs
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@stellarplatform.com>
To: chloe_martin@redwoodai.com
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@stellarplatform.com>
Date: 2026-05-08T09:17:00-07:00
Subject: New vendor: onboarding docs + data escrow requirement

Hi Chloe,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We're starting the procurement intake for Stellar Platform to engage Redwood as a vendor for inference capacity. Our compliance team has a few mandatory items before legal signs a PO:

- Signed DPA (we'll need to attach to the PO)
- Link to your most recent SOC 2 Type II report or the read-only link
- Current subprocessor roster (including cloud infra and any analytics third parties)
- Confirmation whether you support a data escrow arrangement (we require escrow for models trained on customer data in certain deals)

I've attached our onboarding questionnaire (Stellar_Onboarding_Form.pdf) — answers will speed up the review. Also, please outline your standard PO remit details and whether Redwood accepts Net30 or prefers alternative terms.

Can you send the items above by end of day Friday so our legal can draft the PO? If there's anything that needs an exec exception (e.g., data escrow), flag it and we can route.

Best,

Marta Ruiz
Senior Procurement Manager | Stellar Platform
marta.ruiz@stellarplatform.com
+1 415-555-0198

From: chloe_martin@redwoodai.com
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@stellarplatform.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwoodai.com, aditya_rao@redwoodai.com
Date: 2026-05-08T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor: onboarding docs + data escrow requirement

Hi Marta — thanks for the checklist and for looping us in. We can get everything you requested over; below is an initial package and a couple of clarifying notes.

What I'm attaching now:
- Redwood_DPA_for_review.pdf (our standard DPA, editable)
- redwood_subprocessors_list.csv (current subprocessor roster, last updated 2026-04-15)
- SOC2_report_link.txt (permalink to our SOC 2 Type II)

SOC2: https://redwood-inference.s3.amazonaws.com/soc2/2025-type2-report.pdf (read-only link; password: redwood-soc2-2025)

Data escrow: we do not currently maintain a general-purpose escrow for model artifacts. For customers with regulated data we can discuss a scoped escrow or escrow-lite arrangement — typically this adds a small coordination and storage fee and requires legal review. If Stellar's compliance team can share the escrow triggers (what data / trained artifacts / retention triggers), we can draft options and an estimated cost.

PO/payment terms: Redwood generally accepts Net30 by default; we can consider Net45 with a contract amendment for large enterprise deals. Please confirm the billing entity and remit address you plan to use so we can generate an internal invoice path.

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll upload the DPA to DocuSign if your legal prefers the executed DPA attached to the PO.
2) If escrow is required, can your team send a short note of the escrow scope and the compliance driver (regulation/contract clause)? We’ll loop in our legal and security for a one-week turnaround on a proposal.
3) We can schedule a 30-min alignment call Thursday 5/10 to walk through any sensitive points.

I’ve copied Marcus (legal) and Aditya (customer ops) for any redlines and PO routing questions.

Thanks —

Chloe Martin
Senior Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
chloe_martin@redwoodai.com
+1 415-555-0182

---
Attachments: Redwood_DPA_for_review.pdf (application/pdf, 210KB); redwood_subprocessors_list.csv (text/csv, 14KB); SOC2_report_link.txt (text/plain, 1KB)

From: marcus_lin@redwoodai.com
To: chloe_martin@redwoodai.com
Cc: aditya_rao@redwoodai.com
Date: 2026-05-08T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor: onboarding docs + data escrow requirement

Looping in a quick thought from Legal —

Chloe, good starter package. A few negotiating points we'd likely push if Stellar asks for a full escrow:

- Scope: limit to customer-specific trained models and exclude derivative runtime artifacts (we've got IP concerns).
- Trigger: avoid overly-broad triggers; align to insolvency or failure-to-serve SLAs.
- Access controls: escrow custodian must support RBAC and audit logs; Redwood will require subcontractor vetting.

If Stellar is open to an "escrow-lite" (time-limited snapshot + retrieval SLA) we can meet their compliance ask without full escrow complexity. Aditya — can you confirm typical pricing delta for scoped escrow?

-Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of Legal Operations | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwoodai.com

---
(Internal note: keep all redlines in the DPA file; we'll prepare a redline version if Stellar returns comments.)

From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@stellarplatform.com>
To: chloe_martin@redwoodai.com
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@stellarplatform.com>
Date: 2026-05-09T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor: onboarding docs + data escrow requirement

Chloe — thank you, that package helps a lot. A couple quick answers and asks from our side:

- We'll have legal review the DPA; please prepare a DocuSign-ready copy (we prefer executed DPAs attached to the PO).
- SOC2 link/check validated. We will share a short list of subprocessor questions but the roster is sufficient for first pass.
- Escrow: our requirement is limited to models trained on PII and only in cases where Stellar provides the training dataset. That should map well to the "escrow-lite" you described. Please send a short proposal for escrow-lite (scope + pricing estimate).
- PO: attached our purchase_order_template.xlsx — we typically issue Net30. Please confirm invoice remit and whether Redwood needs a separate W-9 (US) or VAT form (EU) — we'll include the requested fields in the PO.

If you can send the DocuSign link and the escrow proposal by EOD Wednesday, procurement should be able to circulate the PO the following week.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Marta Ruiz
Senior Procurement Manager | Stellar Platform
---
